lines.text: Paul says the strong should bear with the weak and please their neighbors to build them up.
Christ did not please Himself, and the Scripture says the insults of those who insult God fell on Him.
Paul says to accept one another as Christ accepted you, and Christ became a servant of the circumcised.
Paul quotes Scripture telling the Gentiles to praise God, and to rejoice with His kings.
Isaiah says the Root of Jesse will rule the Gentiles, and believers overflow with hope by the power of the apostles.
